# Temp Mail

> Temp Mail is a free temporary (disposable) email service. Create a throwaway
> inbox instantly, receive emails, and read them without registration. Built for
> privacy — sign up for services, verify accounts, and avoid spam without giving
> out your real address.

## Overview

- No registration or personal details required.
- Pick a custom username or get a random address.
- Messages arrive in real time and can be viewed in the browser.
- Inboxes are temporary and meant for short-lived use, not long-term storage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://temp-mail.abhi.at/): Create a temporary email address and receive messages.
- [PikoReels](https://temp-mail.abhi.at/pikoreels): A creator resource for making, planning, and publishing short-form video.

## Notes

- Individual mailbox pages (/mailbox/*) are private, ephemeral, and not indexed.
- Do not use temporary inboxes for sensitive or important accounts.
